title: Save Task Edits Icon Color
description: Save Task Edits Icon Color needs to be blue

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Changed the task detail edit-mode save icon from Color.Success to Color.Primary so Save Task Edits renders with the primary blue affordance. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed; route-smoke passed 6/6 against http://127.0.0.1:5099. Browser read-only validation selected TSK-0167 successfully, but edit-only action buttons were not rendered in the unauthenticated page state.
